Name: Stardew Enhanced - Shortcuts
Author: XCube591
Description:
[center][b]   [img]https://i.imgur.com/ELs49Dy.png[/img][/b]
[b]Patchnotes[/b]
[spoiler]
[b]2.2.0 [/b]- Changed the way custom shortcut warps are loaded ﻿ ﻿ 
(to prevent NPCs from doing dum dum stuff) ﻿ ﻿  
[b]2.1.2 [/b]- Fixed Horse issues ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿  
[b]2.1.1 [/b]- Fixed NPCs trying to use shortcuts instead of normal paths     
[b]2.1.0 - [/b]Added a config file - you can now turn each shortcut on or off 
if it clashes with other mods/you don't like it etc. ﻿    
- Made the shortcuts wide enough for Horses ﻿ ﻿     
- Added a new Town Shortcut ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿        
- BUGFIXES: Tile fixes, changed the Sewers shortcut so    
that it works with the Trashbear changes
[/spoiler]

[size=4][i]shortcuts [/i][font=Georgia]adds multiple pathways throughout Stardew Valley [/font]
[/size][font=Georgia][size=4]to make travelling from one place more... convenient? Yeah.[/size]

[b][font=Comic Sans MS]﻿[size=5]________________________________________[/size][/font][/b]

[/font][font=Georgia][size=4]This mod is made to be as lightweight and compatible with[/size]
[/font][size=4][font=Georgia]anything else:[/font]
[/size]
[font=Arial][size=3]- [b]No custom textures[/b] - works with recolours/retextures ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[/size]

[size=3]- It doesn't replace the whole maps, therefore it should work ﻿     
with [/size][size=3]things like Stardew Valley Expanded ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿     [/size]
[size=1](If anyone could try that out and report back it'd be extremely helpful) ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿
[/size]
[size=3]- You can turn each shortcut [b]on[/b] or [b]off[/b] in the config file ﻿ ﻿  ﻿ [/size]

[/font][size=3][font=Arial]- All the shortcuts are [b]blocked[/b] for NPCs, so it doesn't ﻿ ﻿ ﻿   
mess up their pathing ﻿ ﻿[/font] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿   [/size]

[font=Arial][b][size=4]How to install:[/size][/b]

[size=3]1. Install [b]SMAPI[/b],[b]Content Patcher [/b]and[b] TMXLoader[/b]
2. Download with a mod manager  
[b]OR 
[/b]2. Extract (Unzip) into the Mods folder in your Stardew Valley Directory.
3. Done![/size]

[b][u][size=3]If you are applying this mod to an ongoing game:[/size][/u][/b]
[size=2]As this mod changes some bush placements,
it is very important to reset terrain features.

[b]OPTION 1:
[/b]1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4715]Reset Terrain Features[/url][b]﻿ [/b]by MabelSyrup.
2. Enter the game
3. Press 'L' / Open up the mod menu
4. Tick "Affect all locations" and "Bushes"
5. Click "Reset".

[b]OPTION 2:[/b]
1. Download[b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2269]Entoarox Framework[/url][b]﻿ [/b]by Entoarox
2. Enter the game
3. Alt + Tab and select the SMAPI console*
*(the black window with a Stardew Valley logo that opens alongside your game)
4. Type [b]"world_bushreset"[/b] without the quotation marks.[/size][/font]
